story: Four riders escaped within the first kilometre. Aznar, Ferron and Ibanez were caught with 1 km to go. Marc Brustenga launched an attack in the final kilometre but was unsuccessful. Ben Tulett maintained a high pace, and Matthew Brennan secured the stage victory.
